'''Philip Vasquez''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Boca Raton tournament]] on 17 September 2000 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1237">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-boca-raton-fl-9-17-00d1237/ boca-raton-fl-9-17-00], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 17 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-17-boca-raton-fl-9-17-00d1237/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
